mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the model to produce an Operation with no performer and outcome OutSuccess, directly violating FR-001 and the AuthRequiredEverywhere predicate.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthBypass { some op: Operation | no op.performer and op.outcome = OutSuccess }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a successful OpDelete to exist with no corresponding DeletionRecord, breaking the audit-completeness invariant from FR-018.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingDeletionLog { some op: Operation | op.kind = OpDelete and op.outcome = OutSuccess and (no dr: DeletionRecord | dr.loggedTask = op.targetTask) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows two DeletionRecords to share the same (loggedTask, loggedDeleter) pair, simulating a mutated or duplicated log entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateDeletionRecord { some disj dr1, dr2: DeletionRecord | dr1.loggedTask = dr2.loggedTask and dr1.loggedDeleter = dr2.loggedDeleter }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a PATCH on a Done task to succeed without providing a non-Done requestedStatus, which is precisely what FR-011 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClosedTaskBypass { some op: Operation | op.kind = OpPatch and some op.targetTask and op.targetTask.status = Done and op.outcome = OutSuccess and op.requestedStatus = Done }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an authenticated caller to receive OutAuthFail even when their operation kind is in the allowed set, violating the flat-peer permission model.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_FlatPermissionViolation { some op: Operation | one op.performer and op.kind in PermMatrix.Allowed and op.outcome = OutAuthFail }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a DeletionRecord to exist whose loggedDeleter does not match the performer of any corresponding OpDelete, breaking attribution correctness.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_WrongAttribution { some dr: DeletionRecord | all op: Operation | not (op.kind = OpDelete and op.outcome = OutSuccess and op.targetTask = dr.loggedTask and op.performer = dr.loggedDeleter) }
